Nothing's CMF Sub-brand Becomes Majority Indian-Owned Company

Nothing's sub-brand, CMF, is becoming a standalone company and has declared itself 'Indian'. The new company will be majority Indian-owned, according to Nothing CEO Pei. CMF is splitting from its London-headquartered parent company, Nothing.
